This is based on the implementation of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. sources.snippet: This page provides a comprehensive overview of the Qwen2.5 model variants, their sizes, architectures, and capabilities. It explains the different model sizes available, the distinction between base and instruction-tuned variants, and the key capabilities of each model.
